notes.title: Shuttered Releases on September 29th
notes.content: [p]The terrifying new horror game from Evilkookey Games, Shuttered, is set to release on the 29th of September 2025.[/p][p]Wishlist now to be notified when the game launches![/p]

notes.title: Demo Hotfix
notes.content: [p]There was a bug in the demo where some players would be able to finish the level after finding only one spirit rather than the intended 5. This is now patched and I am working on a few other bugs that have come up since the demo was released.[/p]
